decided.singular: Narrow spikes that rise well above the nearby trace: about 115 on day 1, about 95 around days 68-70, about 86 at day 80, about 117 at day 122, about 114 at days 134-135, about 86 at day 174, about 85 at day 239 and about 89 at day 365, against a typical level of 10-30.
decided.highest: Q1 has the broad multi-day episodes with a raised baseline (30-60 around days 35-45, 60-85), while the rest of the year mostly sits around 10-20.
decided.lowest: Q3, especially days 182-215, has the flattest and lowest baseline (about 10-15) with few episodes; Q4 is similar, so this is a close call.
decided.recurrence: There are bumps every few days in places, but no regular 5-10 day rhythm can be seen reliably at this compression of 8760 points.

answer.guess: Hourly particulate matter (PM10/PM2.5) concentration at a European station, with New Year fireworks spikes on days 1 and 365 and winter episodes in Q1.
